newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-Finnlines Jan-Aug profit seen up. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Finnlines Jan-Aug profit seen up. [CORRECTED]

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 296 million markka median forecast for shipping company Finnlines Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
(Corrects all forecasts to include book profit from Finnlines' divestment of trucking arm Huolintakeskus.)
The results are due on September 27. @
In January-August 1995, Finnlines posted a 202 million markka profit.
For Finnlines' full-year 1996 profit, 10 of the 12 analysts polled gave a mean forecast of 392 million markka (range 333-437 million). The 1995 profit was 315 million markka.
The data was collected in the fourth week of September.

Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities and Opstock.
